rules.statement: The mere fact that a fresh offer of an enhanced sum is made after the close of the sale by auction is not of itself enough to justify the Court in refusing to confirm the sale.
rules.supporting_quote: In my opinion the mere fact that a fresh offer of an enhanced sum is made after the close of the sale by auction is not of itself enough to justify the Court in refusing to confirm the sale, and I think therefore that the Court was not entitled to refuse to confirm the sale on that ground.
